title: Design exercise: SAA-3.3-S03
scenario: Teasel Hollow Conservation Trust is replacing a spreadsheet-based field-survey system with a new database-backed application. Its mapping code finds every sighting within a radius of a point using a spatial-query extension, and its species search tolerates misspellings using a fuzzy text-matching extension; the developers will not rewrite either feature. Volunteers upload surveys in weekend bursts, so the database is almost idle for about 20 hours of a typical day and load can jump fifty-fold within minutes at unpredictable times. The three-person team does not want to choose, forecast or resize an instance class.
constraints: Do not claim live AWS experience
No application rewrite is planned for the two extension-based features
Finance will not pay for a large database instance that idles 20 hours a day
Nobody on the team is to forecast capacity or resize the database as load changes

rubric.label: The engine chosen supports both extension-based features with no rewrite, and the record states why the other common open-source SQL engine does not fit
Cost stays low across the roughly 20 idle hours and the fifty-fold bursts are absorbed without anyone choosing or resizing an instance class

constraint_reason: Mapped as design_exercise to complete skill coverage when no dedicated live lab step exists
